facts.text: I am looking for gift ideas for my friends' birthdays.
I recently got a silver necklace with a small pendant from Zara for my sister's 25th birthday.
The Zara silver necklace with a small pendant cost $40.
I like the personalized necklace idea.

I think I will go with Etsy for my friend's gift.
I want to get something similar to the Zara silver necklace with a small pendant but more personalized.
I want to find a similar style on Etsy.
I want more information about Etsy sellers who offer rush orders or expedited shipping.
